description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Hurtling Charge Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Hurtling Charge Mode
description.text: Grants [PHY +15% Boost 1]/[PHY +30% Boost 1]/[PHY +50% Boost 1]/[PHY +70% Boost 1] and [Dualcast Earth, Holy 1]/[Triplecast Earth, Holy 1]/[Quadracast Earth, Holy 1]/[Exacast Earth, Holy 1] at Earnest Agent level 1/2/3/4 after using Stalwart Stance, sets Earnest Agent level to 0 after using a Earth or Holy ability
